stack: Python 3.11+ (Click 8, pandas 2.2, Jinja2 3.1, Pillow 11, matplotlib 3.10, seaborn 0.13)

components.name: harness
components.purpose_one_line: click-based cli that runs one strategy on one seed and emits a validationreport (markdown + json) plus the candidate artifact

components.name: benchmark
components.purpose_one_line: multi-seed sweep runner that fans out across cores and emits summary.md + summary.json + per_seed.ndjson with aggregates, failure-mode breakdown, exemplar seeds, and a/b support

components.name: visualizer
components.purpose_one_line: renders candidates as tile-art grids, plots metric distributions (histogram + ecdf), diffs two candidates per-tile, and overlays reachability heatmaps

data_sources.name: rom
data_sources.purpose: ROM bytes for The Magic of Scheherazade; shared with TMOS_Randomizer_V2 via path reference, never copy

data_sources.name: snapshots
data_sources.purpose: Pre-parsed JSON snapshots of the ROM (cached artifact per REQUIREMENTS.md §8 Q3 — decouples Lab from V2 parser churn and speeds up cold starts)

project_level_folders.name: src
project_level_folders.purpose: Home for the shared tmos_strategy_lab Python package — LabContext, Candidate, registry, metrics/, viz/, strategies/ — imported by all three components

project_level_folders.name: notebooks
project_level_folders.purpose: Jupyter exploratory work outside the main pipeline; nbstripout pre-commit keeps diffs clean (REQUIREMENTS.md §8 Q6)

project_level_folders.name: tests
project_level_folders.purpose: Harness and metric tests — strategies explicitly NOT required to be tested per REQUIREMENTS.md §5
